name: Wetail Shipping Integration
author: Wetail

sections.description:
Wetail Shipping makes it easy to connect your WooCommerce shop to the most common carriers on the Scandinavian market. This plugin allows you to book your carrier services for pickup and print shipping labels directly from WooCommerce order admin with ease.

Supported Carriers

  • Postnord
  • DHL
  • Schenker
  • Bring
  • Budbee
  • Best Transport

How to get started

  1. Download and install the plugin on your shop
  2. Set up your account at Wetail and receive your license key
  3. Add your license key to your WooCommerce installation
  4. Map your shop shipping options with Carrier services
  5. Get started shipping

Features

  • Book carrier pickup from WooCommerce order admin
  • Print shipping labels from WooCommerce order admin
  • Manage return labels
  • Customs declaration documents
  • Track & Trace in order emails
  • Bulk printing
  • Return portal included for smooth returns

Get a Wetail Account

Suitable pricing plans for all shop sizes. Start with pay-as-you-go and grow to enterprise plans
https://wetail.io/integrationer/wetail-shipping/

Installation Docs

https://docs.wetail.io/

Usage of data

Wetail sends data to the wetail.io domain (in the case of dev mode, wetail.dev is being used). Data will further be processed by the chosen third party shipping provider. Wetail only sends the data that is needed in order to provide the shipping label from each provider.

Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

Terms of Use: https://wetail.io/terms-of-use-and-privacy-policies/wetail-shipping-terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://wetail.io/terms-of-use-and-privacy-policies/wetail-shipping-privacy-policy/
sections.changelog:
1.2.5

  • Bugfix for company name.

1.2.4

  • Bugfix for customer.

1.2.3

  • Company name is sent to WS API when creating a label.

1.2.2

  • Correction of automatic printing flow, order validation, choosing sender and pickup booking is enabled when creating a label manually.
  • Correction of manual printing flow when creating a label manually from single order view.
  • Translations updated

1.2.1

  • Correction of automatic printing flow.

1.2.0

  • Enhanced error handling logic across shipping label workflows, including adding alert fallbacks for tooltip failures.
  • Simplified and centralized button rendering logic in admin PHP and JS files.
  • Improved consistency and organization in SCSS for admin UI elements.
  • Implemented support for manual label creation and input fields for product quantities.
  • Removed deprecated and unused logic for better code maintainability.
  • Streamlined asset loading and eliminated redundant functions.
  • Handle shipping mapping error

1.1.5

  • Improvement: Qr code support in Return Portal

1.1.4

  • Feature: Added support for HS Tariff codes for Customs Documents
  • Bugfix: Scheduled synchronization of an order has been corrected

1.1.3

  • Code refactoring and unit tests implementation

1.1.2

  • Scheduling issue corrected for orders that are being synced on status processing

1.1.1

  • Hotfix

1.1.0

  • “Return Portal” is implemented

1.0.5

  • Feature: Green check mark in order listing is only visible if label has been printed
  • Bugfix: In some themes the print screen was bigger than actual screen. This is corrected.
  • Bugfix: Decimals are allowed in settings field for minimum weight
  • Bugfix: Space in tracking link in order comments
  • Feature: Plugin now has own database table for storing labels. Previously it was stored in order meta

1.0.4

  • Bugfix: WooCommerce Order hook on status change failed, its corrected
  • Feature: Product Packing Dimensions loads weight and dimensions at initial load if Product Packing Dimensions entry is not existing for product

1.0.3

  • Bugfix: HPOS support fix
  • Bugfix: Link corrections

1.0.1

  • Bugfix: Bulk print
  • Bugfix: Order shipping company is used as receiver name instead of Order billing company if receiver is a company

1.0

  • Official version
